title: T-3 lifecycle events on the shipped path carry only allowed metadata keys
asA: reviewer verifying the platform-cloudflare-durable-objects v1.0.0 blueprint at mechanism reach
iWant: every lifecycle event emitted on the shipped code path to carry only the allowed metadata keys and never a forbidden key
soThat: a logging companion can render the sink directly without a per-blueprint scrub pass

acceptanceCriteria.description: The event-secrecy result on the websocket-hub-broadcast probe scans every record emitted through the facade and both DO classes on the shipped path and asserts every top-level key is drawn from {event, key, size, ttl, timestamp, objectName, scheduledTime}. Under SIMULATE_PII_LEAK=true a wrapped sink forwards a synthetic body-bearing record; the probe surfaces the forbidden keys (body, ssn, userId) and returns fail on the AC-33106-1 result.
acceptanceCriteria.given: a driven facade + single-cell + hub with an accumulating spy sink, and the SIMULATE_PII_LEAK switch
acceptanceCriteria.when: the event-secrecy AC-33106-1 result runs on the shipped path and the simulate path
acceptanceCriteria.then: the shipped path returns pass with zero forbidden keys; the simulate path surfaces the injected fields and returns fail
